6a5925487ad43da3.description: Position Overview We are seeking a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to join our remote administrative and data management team. This entry-level position focuses on accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining business information across company databases, spreadsheets, and digital record systems. The successful candidate will also provide administrative support, organize electronic documents, assist with reporting, and help maintain efficient day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable using computers, follows instructions carefully, pays close attention to detail, and can manage assigned tasks independently in a remote work environment. Previous professional experience is not required. Comprehensive onboarding, training, and ongoing guidance will be provided. Recent graduates, career changers, individuals returning to the workforce, and candidates seeking their first remote administrative opportunity are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Data Entry & Information Processing Enter, update, and maintain information in company databases, spreadsheets, and internal systems. Transfer information accurately from approved source documents. Review entered data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Process assigned data-entry tasks within established deadlines. Identify missing, duplicate, outdated, or inconsistent information. Make routine corrections and updates when authorized. Maintain accurate processing logs and records of completed assignments. Follow established data-entry standards and formatting procedures. Database & Records Administration Maintain accurate electronic records and internal databases. Update customer, administrative, and operational information as assigned. Verify information against approved source records. Organize records using established categories and naming conventions. Assist with routine database cleanup and maintenance. Identify incomplete or inconsistent records. Maintain documentation of completed updates and processing activities. Follow company confidentiality and information-security procedures. Administrative & Clerical Support Provide routine administrative and clerical assistance to assigned teams. Prepare and update forms, spreadsheets, reports, lists, and internal documents. Assist with organizing administrative records and digital resources. Process routine information requests and documentation updates. Maintain task trackers, schedules, and administrative logs. Support email correspondence and shared inbox management when assigned. Route information and documents to appropriate departments. Assist with general administrative and operational activities. Spreadsheet & Reporting Support Enter and organize information in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools. Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, databases, and routine reports. Sort, filter, and categorize information according to instructions. Perform basic spreadsheet formatting and organization. Compare information across spreadsheets and internal systems. Identify duplicate entries and inconsistent information. Assist with compiling data for internal reporting. Keep assigned tracking documents accurate and up to date. Document Processing & Digital File Management Prepare, upload, download, label, categorize, and organize digital documents. Review forms and supporting documentation for completeness. Maintain electronic filing systems and shared folders. Follow established file-naming and document-storage procedures. Retrieve authorized documents and records when requested. Archive completed files according to company guidelines. Report missing, incomplete, or unclear documentation. Maintain document-processing logs and trackers. Data Verification & Quality Control Review completed data-entry and administrative work before submission. Check for typing, formatting, numerical, and information-entry errors. Compare entered information against approved source documents. Verify required fields and supporting information. Identify incomplete or inconsistent records. Correct routine errors when authorized. Escalate unresolved discrepancies to the appropriate team member. Follow established quality-control and accuracy standards. Scheduling & Task Coordination Assist with routine scheduling, calendar updates, and administrative coordination. Maintain task lists, deadlines, and progress trackers. Track open, pending, and completed assignments. Provide updates regarding assigned tasks and outstanding requests. Follow up on routine action items when required. Request clarification when instructions or information are incomplete. Report processing delays or technical issues promptly. Support the timely completion of administrative workflows. Remote Team Collaboration Communicate professionally through email, chat, and virtual meetings. Coordinate data-entry and administrative requests with colleagues. Provide regular updates on assigned tasks and completed work. Participate in virtual onboarding, training, meetings, and coaching. Follow established remote-work policies and procedures. Maintain dependable communication during scheduled working hours. Work independently while meeting deadlines and quality expectations. Desired Candidate Profile High school diploma, GED, or equivalent. Basic computer and typing proficiency. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good written and verbal communication skills. Basic knowledge of spreadsheets, email, and digital documents. Good organizational and time-management skills. Ability to enter and review information accurately. Ability to follow written instructions and established procedures. Ability to perform repetitive tasks consistently. Basic problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple routine assignments. Willingness to learn new software and administrative systems. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Dependable and professional work habits. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Reliable internet connection and suitable remote workspace.

6a46ee0b5dfbfeee.description: Mechanical Technician Valve Overhauling, On-Site Machining & Field Service Job Title: Mechanical Technician Department: On-Site Intervention Services Reports To: Specialty Services manager Job Summary The Mechanical Technician is responsible for performing industrial valve inspection, overhauling, repair, testing, and reassembly, as well as precision on-site machining and mechanical field service activities at workshops and client facilities. The role supports maintenance, shutdowns, turnarounds, and emergency interventions across oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, and other industrial sectors. The position requires practical expertise in valve maintenance, portable machining, mechanical fitting, equipment alignment, and troubleshooting, with a strong commitment to health, safety, quality, and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Valve Overhauling and Maintenance Dismantle, inspect, repair, reassemble, and test industrial valves, including gate, globe, ball, butterfly, check, and control valves. Perform valve lapping, grinding, seat restoration, and replacement of defective components, seals, and gaskets. Conduct hydrostatic, pneumatic, pressure, and functional testing in accordance with approved procedures and applicable standards. Diagnose valve leakage, mechanical defects, and operational issues, ensuring correct assembly and reliable performance. Record inspection findings, repair activities, test results, and material replacements. On-Site Machining and Field Services Operate portable machining equipment for flange facing, line boring, milling, drilling, and other precision machining operations. Perform in-situ machining and repair of valves, flanges, pumps, and associated mechanical components. Set up, secure, and align machining equipment, verifying dimensions, tolerances, and surface finish requirements. Carry out mechanical installation, alignment, adjustment, and troubleshooting at client sites. Inspect and maintain machining tools and equipment to ensure safe and reliable operation. Mechanical Maintenance and Field Support Execute mechanical fitting, dismantling, component replacement, reassembly, installation, and maintenance activities. Support planned shutdowns, plant turnarounds, preventive maintenance, and emergency service assignments. Interpret technical drawings, equipment specifications, and maintenance procedures to complete assigned tasks accurately. Coordinate with supervisors, engineers, and client representatives to ensure efficient execution of work. Prepare accurate service reports, inspection records, measurement reports, and job completion documentation. Health, Safety, Quality, and Compliance Comply with company and client HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, risk assessments, and approved work procedures. Follow lockout/tagout (LOTO), equipment isolation, PPE, and other applicable safety requirements. Ensure all work meets specified quality standards, dimensional tolerances, and approved technical procedures. Inspect tools and equipment before use and promptly report unsafe conditions, incidents, defects, and non-conformities. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment at all times. Qualifications and Experience Technical diploma, ITI, vocational certificate, or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Maintenance, or a related discipline. Typically 3 5 years of relevant industrial experience in valve overhauling , mechanical maintenance, on-site machining , or field services. Demonstrated hands-on experience in industrial valve repair, assembly, inspection, and pressure testing. Practical knowledge of portable machining equipment, precision measuring instruments, and mechanical hand tools. Ability to interpret technical drawings, understand mechanical tolerances, and follow maintenance procedures. Experience in oil and gas, petrochemical, refinery, power generation, or other heavy industrial environments is preferred. Shutdown, turnaround, and emergency maintenance experience is an advantage. Technical Skills and Competencies Industrial valve inspection, dismantling, repair, lapping, grinding, and reassembly. Valve pressure testing, functional testing, and sealing surface restoration. Portable flange facing, line boring, milling, drilling, and in-situ machining. Mechanical fitting, equipment alignment, dimensional measurement, and troubleshooting. Understanding of mechanical tolerances, surface finishes, equipment specifications, and quality requirements. Safe operation and basic maintenance of portable machining equipment and workshop tools. Accurate completion of technical reports, inspection records, and service documentation. Strong mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, teamwork, and effective communication. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver quality workmanship within project deadlines. Working Conditions and Job Requirements Work in workshops, industrial plants, client facilities, and remote project locations. Availability for site deployment, business travel, overtime, shift work, and extended working hours as required by project needs. Ability to work in demanding industrial environments and comply with applicable site access, safety training, and medical requirements. Maintain professional conduct and demonstrate a customer-focused approach throughout service assignments. Performance Expectations Complete assigned valve overhauling, machining, and mechanical service activities safely and within agreed schedules. Meet specified quality standards, dimensional tolerances, and testing requirements. Minimize rework through accurate inspection, correct assembly, and adherence to approved procedures. Maintain tools, machinery, and equipment in safe and serviceable condition. Submit complete and accurate job reports and service documentation on time. Demonstrate accountability, teamwork, and commitment to safety and customer satisfaction. Desired Candidate Profile Technical diploma, ITI, vocational certificate, or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Maintenance, or a related discipline. Typically 3 5 years of relevant industrial experience in valve overhauling , mechanical maintenance, on-site machining , or field services. Demonstrated hands-on experience in industrial valve repair, assembly, inspection, and pressure testing. Practical knowledge of portable machining equipment, precision measuring instruments, and mechanical hand tools. Ability to interpret technical drawings, understand mechanical tolerances, and follow maintenance procedures. Experience in oil and gas, petrochemical, refinery, power generation, or other heavy industrial environments is preferred. Shutdown, turnaround, and emergency maintenance experience is an advantage.

6a6534ff4443a8fa.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Scrap Inspector to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position is critical for ensuring the quality and proper handling of incoming scrap materials and maintaining yard standards. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Segregate unwanted material and unprepared scrap by spreading offloaded scrap on the floor. Classify scrap quality and category based on approved Internal Scrap Standards. Report abnormalities, deductions, and rejections of loaded-back scrap with relevant pictures or evidence. Shift segregated oversize material and unwanted material to the designated area at the end of each shift. Maintain provided PPEs in good, workable conditions. Avoid horseplay and abuse of safety devices, equipment, and welfare facilities. Report any accidents, near misses, or hazardous conditions to the responsible personnel. Attend planned safety trainings. Exercise the right to refuse unsafe work. Ensure the safety of coworkers and machinery/scrap handling equipment. Maintain yard housekeeping and an environmentally friendly surrounding. Qualifications and Experience 1-2 years of relevant experience. Ability to perform physical measurements and visual estimations accurately. Strong attention to detail for material segregation and classification. Basic understanding of safety protocols in an industrial environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, requiring on-site presence in the scrap yard. The role involves coordination with various team members and adherence to strict safety guidelines.

افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات مع المشاريع والبرامج الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها بفعالية. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقًا للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والمتابعة وإدارة الموارد. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المذنب، القصيم، ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع فرق العمل الداخلية والإدارة العليا. نطاق المسؤولية يتضمن الدور مسؤولية وضع وتتبع موازنات المشاريع وإجراءاتها التعاقدية، وتحديد تكاليفها ومصادر تمويلها، ومتابعة عمليات التنفيذ لضمان إنجازها وتحقيق أهدافها بناءً على الجدول الزمني والميزانية المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. تشجع الشركة المتقدمين الذين يمتلكون الخبرة المطلوبة والقدرة على قيادة المشاريع بفعالية على التقديم.

6ab19d2bcdd285c8.description: About the Role Moody's Corporation is seeking an Associate Director Project Manager to join the Middle East Lending Implementation Services team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role involves leading large-scale lending technology implementation projects for clients across the Middle East, with a primary focus on Saudi Arabia. Team Overview The Middle East Lending Implementation Services team, part of Moody's Banking Customer Engagement, is responsible for the planning and delivery of lending technology implementation projects for clients in the region. The team focuses on strengthening client relationships and establishing project management best practices. It incorporates Generative and Agentic AI tools to streamline workflows and support client advisory, while maintaining strong governance and responsible AI practices. The successful candidate will contribute to transformative lending technology projects within financial institutions in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. Key Responsibilities Lead the delivery of large-scale lending technology implementation projects for Moody's clients across the Middle East. Prioritize, plan, and manage projects within an assigned portfolio. Manage organizational team deliverables and project responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle. Plan, coordinate, and prioritize project efforts, accurately capturing and communicating project priorities. Build and maintain relationships with client project teams and other stakeholders. Record and manage project issues and risks, escalating as necessary. Control project scope and manage change management processes. Coordinate the work of consultants and allocate resources efficiently, fostering a cooperative and motivated project team. Provide expertise and consulting to other project managers on project management practices, team dynamics, team building, and group motivation. Provide analysis and recommendations, and develop content to continuously improve project management methodologies, processes, and documentation. Ensure adherence to governance guidelines set by the Project Management Office (PMO). Liaise with internal functions such as Product Management, Engineering, and Client Services. Report on project progress to clients, senior internal stakeholders, and delivery team members. Provide services that satisfy existing or new client business needs, and offer proactive solution and product support to clients. Engage with clients on-site and off-site in a professional and timely manner. Support pre-sales activities upon request from a services perspective. Work Location and Onboarding This position is based in Moody's Riyadh office in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will initially undergo onboarding at Moody's Middle East headquarters in Dubai before relocating to Riyadh to support financial institutions within Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates who are interested in this opportunity are encouraged to apply, even if they do not meet every single requirement. Moody's values individuals who invest in relationships, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

cases and agent opportunities Demonstrate and build simple AI agents to showcase tangible business value Manage adoption programs, including planning, tracking, KPIs, and outcomes Drive change management initiatives to ensure sustainable adoption at scale Communicate effectively across business and technical audiences Collaborate closely with architects, engineers, and engagement teams What 6a1e8dd3e5369b18.description: About the Role Accor is seeking a Director of Spa to lead Ciel Spa at SLS The Red Sea. This full-time role involves overseeing the spa operation, ensuring guest experiences, maintaining treatment standards, and managing commercial performance. The Director of Spa will curate wellness experiences that align with the SLS identity. Company Overview SLS The Red Sea is part of Ennismore’s lifestyle portfolio, known for its design and service. Located on the Red Sea coast, the resort features 150 keys, five Food & Beverage venues, and a spa. SLS The Red Sea aims to provide a blend of indulgence and entertainment, fostering a creative environment for its team. Responsibilities Lead the strategy and daily operation of Ciel Spa, ensuring a personalized guest experience. Establish and maintain standards across treatments, guest journeys, reception, relaxation areas, retail, and all spa facilities. Curate and evolve the treatment menu, wellness experiences, and spa programming. Recruit, lead, train, and develop the Spa team, fostering a culture of service and development. Drive the commercial performance of the spa, including revenue, profitability, treatment utilization, retail sales, and cost management. Develop annual budgets, forecasts, and business plans, monitoring financial performance. Implement revenue management, pricing, packages, promotions, and upselling strategies. Monitor guest feedback, service quality, and industry trends to enhance the spa experience. Develop relationships with premium spa, skincare, beauty, and wellness partners. Partner with other hotel departments to integrate wellness into the wider guest journey. Create seasonal programming, wellness events, and collaborations. Oversee spa inventory, purchasing, retail, product control, and supplier relationships. Ensure spa facilities are presented, maintained, and operationally ready. Maintain hygiene, health, safety, treatment protocols, and guest privacy standards. Establish SOPs, service standards, and training programs. Prepare and analyze operational and financial reports. Stay informed of emerging luxury spa, beauty, and wellness trends. Qualifications and Requirements A degree or diploma in Spa Management, Hospitality, Wellness, Business Management, or a related discipline is preferred. Minimum 5–7 years of spa or wellness experience, with significant experience in a senior leadership role within a luxury hotel, resort, or premium spa environment. Proven experience managing a full-service luxury spa operation, with knowledge of treatments, spa journeys, retail, and wellness programming. Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated experience managing budgets, forecasts, revenue, profitability, payroll, and operational costs. Proven ability to drive treatment utilization, retail performance, upselling, and overall spa revenue. Strong understanding of luxury spa service standards, guest experience, and current wellness trends. Exceptional leadership skills with experience recruiting, training, coaching, and developing a diverse team. Strong knowledge of spa hygiene, health and safety, treatment protocols, and operational compliance. Experience developing treatment menus, packages, promotions, partnerships, and seasonal wellness programming. Excellent guest relations and communication skills with a polished, intuitive, and personalized approach to service. Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to balance commercial performance with guest experience. Experience with spa management and booking systems, Microsoft Office, and relevant hotel operating systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic and additional languages are advantageous. Flexible and hands-on leadership style, with the ability to work according to the operational requirements of a luxury resort environment. Work Type This is a full-time position requiring a flexible and hands-on leadership approach within a luxury resort environment. Application Process Candidates with the required qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply.

6a345a0d41c44c62.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الطازج فروج فقيه المشوي لتقديم الوجبات عن نادل للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وضمان تجربة تناول طعام ممتعة للضيوف. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر فرصة للمرشحين الطموحين لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في قطاع الضيافة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء وتزويدهم بقوائم الأطعمة والمشروبات، ثم تلقي طلباتهم وتقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات بكفاءة. الإجابة عن استفسارات العملاء وتقديم المشورة بشأن خيارات الأطعمة والمشروبات المتاحة. إعداد الطاولات وترتيبها وتنظيفها، بالإضافة إلى ترتيب محتوياتها من الأطباق والأواني وإعادتها إلى أماكنها المخصصة بعد الاستخدام. تقديم الفواتير للعملاء واستلام وتسجيل المدفوعات النقدية، مع استخدام آلات نقاط البيع بدقة. التعامل مع شكاوى العملاء الأولية ورفعها إلى مسؤول الشكاوى تمهيداً للتعامل معها وحلها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بلباقة. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في جدة، مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة الطازج فروج فقيه المشوي لتقديم الوجبات.

6a3899a6803452a6.description: Job Purpose: To manage, supervise, and ensure the successful execution of civil works in 380 kV substation projects (HV/MV), in compliance with Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) standards, contract requirements, safety, and quality guidelines. Key Responsibilities: Supervise, monitor, and control all civil construction activities at the substation site, including foundations, control building, cable trenches, equipment foundations, roads, and fencing. Ensure all works are executed in compliance with SEC standards, drawings, and specifications. Review civil designs, drawings, and shop drawings and coordinate with engineering consultants/contractors for approvals. Coordinate with project stakeholders (SEC representatives, consultants, contractors, and suppliers) for timely progress. Plan and schedule civil construction activities to meet project timelines and milestones. Monitor quality of materials and workmanship, conduct inspections, and ensure adherence to project QA/QC requirements. Ensure strict compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards at the project site. Prepare and maintain project documentation such as daily progress reports, inspection requests, and material approvals. Assist in resolving technical issues, variations, and claims related to civil works. Support the Project Manager in progress meetings and provide input on civil work status and challenges. Ensure timely completion and handover of civil works to enable installation of electrical equipment and overall substation commissioning. Key Competencies: Knowledge of substation civil construction practices. Quality and safety management. Stakeholder management (SEC/consultants/contractors). Planning, scheduling, and execution skills. Ability to work in a multicultural and challenging environment. Desired Candidate Profile Preferred Candidate Profile Experience in EPC Substation Projects within Saudi Arabia. Exposure to SEC, National Grid SA, or major utility projects. Strong track record in delivering substation civil works safely, within budget, and on schedule. Immediate availability with SEC approval or transferable iqama will be an added advantage.

6a47d910f543f06a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم التعديلات الهيكلية والأثاث والتجهيزات للمساحات الداخلية، والمساعدة في الإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات الداخلية والديكورات، وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية وعرضها على العميل، مع إجراء التعديلات المطلوبة. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين والمواد، والإشراف على مراحل التنفيذ. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات تنفيذ التصميمات، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية الداخلية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تصميم التعديلات الهيكلية والأثاث والتجهيزات بما يتناسب مع المساحات الداخلية. مهارات قوية في إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري الداخلي ضمن فريق شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف على المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المعماريين الداخليين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في الهفوف.

6a4ae52eb74efdbb.job_title: SAP Solution Advisor (Pre Sales) Fixed term
6a4ae52eb74efdbb.description: Position Overview Systems Arabia is seeking an experienced SAP Presales Consultant to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting solution consulting, pre-sales activities, and business development initiatives. The consultant will collaborate with sales, delivery, and technology teams to understand customer requirements and design SAP solutions. Role Context The SAP Presales Consultant will be responsible for designing SAP solutions, preparing proposals, conducting demonstrations, and supporting the entire sales lifecycle. This role requires strong SAP solutioning expertise, presentation skills, and the ability to engage with business and executive stakeholders across various industries. Key Responsibilities Engage with customers to understand business requirements and transformation objectives. Lead discovery workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and solution assessments. Design and present end-to-end SAP solutions aligned with customer needs and industry best practices. Support sales teams with opportunity qualification, account strategy, and solution positioning. Prepare technical and commercial proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, and Statements of Work (SoW). Develop solution presentations, implementation approaches, effort estimates, and value propositions. Deliver SAP demonstrations, customer workshops, and executive presentations. Present solution architectures, implementation roadmaps, and business value propositions. Address customer queries and support stakeholders throughout the sales cycle. Stay current with SAP innovations, market trends, and industry developments. Collaborate with internal teams and SAP partners to support go-to-market initiatives and business growth. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in SAP solutioning and pre-sales. Demonstrated expertise in designing and presenting SAP solutions. Ability to engage effectively with business and executive stakeholders. Required Skills Strong SAP solutioning expertise. Excellent presentation and communication skills. Proficiency in preparing technical and commercial proposals. Ability to lead discovery workshops and requirement-gathering sessions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within a collaborative environment that includes sales, delivery, and technology teams.

6a52bbad4269435c.description: نبحث عن سائق توصيل يتمتع بالمسؤولية والالتزام ليكون جزءًا من فريقنا. تتضمن مهامك توصيل الطلبات بكفاءة ودقة مع الحفاظ على سلامة المنتجات. إذا كنت تمتلك رخصة قيادة سارية وتتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة، ندعوك للانضمام إلينا. * توصيل الطلبات إلى العملاء في المواعيد المحددة. * الحفاظ على نظافة وسلامة المركبة المستخدمة في التوصيل. * التعامل بلباقة واحترافية مع العملاء. * اتباع الإرشادات والسياسات الخاصة بالشركة.

6a5a31465ac142a3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جسار البناء للمقاولات، ومقرها في صبيا وجازان، عن مصممة داخلية للانضمام إلى فريقها. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم حلول تصميمية مبتكرة تلبي احتياجات العملاء وتحويل أفكارهم إلى تصاميم قابلة للتنفيذ. تتطلب الوظيفة شغفًا بالتصميم الداخلي والأثاث، بالإضافة إلى مهارات تواصل جيدة مع العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء في المكتب وفهم احتياجاتهم ومتطلباتهم بدقة. إعداد تصاميم داخلية ثلاثية الأبعاد للمساحات السكنية. اقتراح الألوان والخامات والأثاث والتنسيقات المناسبة لكل مشروع. إعداد المخططات والمقاسات اللازمة لضمان تنفيذ التصاميم بدقة. عرض التصاميم على العملاء وإجراء التعديلات المطلوبة بناءً على ملاحظاتهم. التنسيق الفعال مع فريق التنفيذ والموردين والمصانع لضمان توافق التنفيذ مع التصميم المعتمد. المساهمة في استقطاب العملاء وتسويق خدمات الشركة، وتحويل الاستفسارات إلى مشاريع فعلية. متابعة العملاء حتى اعتماد التصميم والاتفاق على نطاق العمل النهائي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي. شغف حقيقي بالتصميم الداخلي والأثاث. القدرة على استخدام برامج التصميم ثلاثي الأبعاد. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء. القدرة على تحويل الأفكار إلى تصاميم عملية وجذابة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. تفاصيل الوظيفة تتوفر هذه الفرصة بدوام جزئي في مدينتي صبيا وجازان. يتراوح الراتب الشهري بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. التقديم للمهتمات بالانضمام إلى فريق جسار البناء للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

6a5d49f19e0c6b35.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع الحديقة الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في أبها، عسير. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها، وتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان المرضية، ثم إعداد خطة العلاج والبرنامج الزمني الخاص بها. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للحالات المرضية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في طب الأسنان أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في ممارسة طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى والزملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية والنظافة. القدرة على استخدام التقنيات والأدوات الحديثة في طب الأسنان. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن بيئة عيادة أسنان حديثة في مجمع الحديقة الطبي بمدينة أبها، عسير. الدور يتطلب التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

6a75e642ca5bfaec.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Senior Specialist, SAP Security to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time role involves managing and governing SAP security, authorizations, access controls, and compliance across various SAP platforms and integrated enterprise applications. The specialist will ensure secure access management, regulatory compliance, and data integrity while supporting internal controls and digital transformation initiatives. Role Context and Purpose The Senior Specialist, SAP Security is responsible for maintaining robust security frameworks within the SAP ecosystem, including SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, and SAP Sales Cloud. This position is critical for ensuring data confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and for supporting the company's cybersecurity requirements and risk management strategies. Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain SAP security roles, profiles, authorizations, and user access across SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Sales Cloud, and related platforms. Design, implement, and maintain role-based access controls in accordance with business requirements and security best practices. Perform Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis, risk assessments, remediation activities, and access conflict reviews. Manage user provisioning, de-provisioning, privileged access, emergency access, and periodic access recertification activities. Support integration of SAP security with Active Directory (AD), Azure AD, Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity Management, and other authentication platforms. Monitor and enforce compliance with company policies, audit requirements, cybersecurity standards, and regulatory obligations. Conduct periodic access reviews and ensure appropriate approval workflows and governance controls are maintained. Support internal and external audits by preparing audit evidence, responding to audit inquiries, and implementing corrective actions. Assess security impacts of SAP projects, enhancements, upgrades, migrations, and digital transformation initiatives. Coordinate with SAP functional teams, Basis, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Internal Audit, and external partners to implement secure solutions. Monitor security vulnerabilities, authorization risks, access violations, and compliance issues, recommending corrective actions. Develop and maintain security standards, procedures, role design documentation, access matrices, and governance frameworks. Support data protection, confidentiality, integrity, and security controls across SAP and integrated business applications. Identify opportunities to strengthen governance, automate security processes, reduce risk exposure, and improve audit readiness. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in SAP security management. Demonstrated expertise in SAP security, authorizations, access controls, and Segregation of Duties (SoD). Experience with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, and SAP Sales Cloud security. Familiarity with identity management, Single Sign-On (SSO), and integration with Active Directory (AD) or Azure AD. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, focusing on maintaining and enhancing the security posture of critical SAP systems within a dynamic enterprise environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role.

6a7eae7d7aa351d7.job_title: Director Public Health and Community Engagement (DEL )
6a7eae7d7aa351d7.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Public Health and Community Engagement to establish and lead the public health function across Qiddiya City. This full-time position, based in Riyadh Province, specifically Riyadh, involves developing Qiddiya’s five-year public health strategy and establishing the necessary policies, standards, and systems to protect the health of residents, employees, contractors, and visitors. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in public health practice. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Qiddiya’s five-year public health plan and establish the public health policy framework, standards, thresholds, and intervention triggers. Translate national health priorities and Ministry of Health requirements into practical policies for Qiddiya City. Design and oversee disease surveillance systems across Qiddiya assets and contracted healthcare provider locations, ensuring compliance with notifiable disease reporting. Lead outbreak investigations, chair the outbreak control team, and oversee contact tracing, disease prevention, and vaccination requirements. Establish occupational health standards for Qiddiya employees, contractors, and service providers, defining health surveillance requirements for specific roles. Provide strategic oversight of community health engagement programs, including the Qiddiya Life Saver Program and Public Access Defibrillator network plan. Lead, manage, and develop the public health team, representing Medical Operations on public health matters internally and externally. Manage budgets, resources, contracts, and departmental priorities, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Public Health Strategy and Policy Development This role involves developing population health profiles, conducting risk assessments, and creating public health data models. The Director will advise the Executive Director on long-term strategy, resource allocation, partnerships, and public health priorities, ensuring alignment with national health objectives. Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Management The Director will be responsible for providing recommendations regarding the closure of venues or assets during public health incidents and maintaining effective reporting and escalation relationships with relevant health authorities. This includes defining environmental health information requirements from internal and external partners. Qualifications and Experience Education: A Master of Public Health, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification in public health, is mandatory. Experience: Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in public health practice. Proven experience in developing a public health plan, policy framework, or program from its inception. Practical experience in disease surveillance and outbreak investigation, including leading or making significant contributions to an outbreak response. Experience working across multiple organizations or functions where responsibilities and authority are shared. General healthcare, hospital, or clinical management experience alone does not substitute for the required public health experience. Work Environment This role involves working closely with government authorities, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure robust public health outcomes for Qiddiya City. The Director will drive continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence within the public health function.

6aac866b11ac206c.description: About the Role Honeywell (KSA) is seeking an Application Engineer I to join its team in Dhahran or Dammam. This full-time position is open to Saudi Nationals only. 6ad41720ecb5dcd9.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking a Quality and Safety Officer to ensure the effective implementation and continuous monitoring of Safety Management Systems (SMS) and Quality Management Systems (QMS). 6ad909d77d8da0c3.description: About the Role T-Maxx International is seeking Arabic speakers to join a remote, part-time project as an Arabic Listening & Language Reviewer. 6a567f980624b203.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an Architectural BIM Modeler to join their team in Riyadh. 6a77285b1bc51453.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

6a9757785a82e807.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Director of Nursery Operations for Botanica, a subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery for Red Sea Global's destinations. Botanica integrates new species with local flora, operating across 1 million square meters with a focus on sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala. This full-time position is based in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj and Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Director of Nursery Operations will lead the operational functions of the 180-hectare Botanica site. This includes overseeing field operations, plant maintenance, plant protection, irrigation and water management (2,000–4,000 m3 per day), soil mix and growing media production, logistics, receiving and dispatch, and facilities, fleet, and workshop management. The primary objective is to ensure plant health, timely and complete order fulfillment, and safe and efficient site operations for all business units. Key Responsibilities Manage and organize all nursery areas, including planting zones (1,533,100 m2), shading (173,800 m2), and mother stock areas. Oversee routine maintenance of nursery stock, including weeding, pruning, spacing, cleaning, and daily plant health monitoring. Implement plant protection measures in accordance with the IPM and biosecurity program. Design, operate, and maintain the irrigation network and pump stations, setting schedules by zone and season. Monitor water quality, flow, and consumption, focusing on reducing freshwater use through TSE, drip, and smart irrigation. Develop and maintain contingency plans for water supply interruptions and system failures. Source raw materials and produce consistent soil mixes and substrates to approved recipes, supplying internal sections and external clients. Manage receiving of local and imported plants and materials, coordinating with Biosecurity for inspection and quarantine. Plan and execute dispatch against confirmed orders, including picking, loading, transport, and delivery documentation. Coordinate imports through the bonded facility and maintain accurate stock movement records. Implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans for facilities, greenhouses, shade structures, and equipment. Manage fleet availability, utilization, and compliance, overseeing workshops and the asset register. Manage the Nursery Operations budget, including labor, water, energy, fuel, spares, and maintenance. Allocate manpower, machinery, and transport across sections, supporting Production and Landscape Maintenance requests. Report monthly KPIs and identify operational risks with corrective actions. Lead section heads, supervisors, and operatives, setting competency and training standards. Control high-risk activities in collaboration with HSSE, including machinery, chemicals, lifting, driving, and heat stress. Fulfill the responsibilities of a Department Head as outlined in Section ** Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Champion the safety, quality, and environmental management system (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301).
